newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to auction 12-month T-bills on Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: Greece to auction 12-month T-bills on Feb 3.

text.p: The Greek finance ministry said it will auction 300 billion drachmas worth of 12-month T-bills on February 3 and issue two-year zero coupon bonds with a pre-tax yield to maturity of 10.30 percent on January 31.
Terms of the T-bill auction and the base rate will be announced on January 30, it said.
Both T-bills and two-year zero coupon bonds will be available in physical and dematerialised form, it said.

The finance ministry also expressed its satisfaction for Moody's investors service to assign a rating of A2 to drachma-denominated Eurobonds and outstanding drachma treasury bonds issued in the domestic market.
